findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. Any caller relying on this authorization helper will therefore permit cross-tenant document access. Preserve the tenant comparison instead of granting every request.

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant comparison before granting document reads
findings.body:
For any `userTenant !== documentTenant`, the function now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access wherever this authorization helper is enforced.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant` will pass the check, enabling cross-tenant document disclosure wherever this exported authorization function is trusted.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
